s4_ref_local_r60_g8_tn15_dmg_pfc.label: Reference swarm (local, radius 0.6, 64-number map, repair-trained)
s4_ref_local_r60_g8_tn15_dmg_pfc.note: Each bot sees only neighbours within about 6 spacings plus an 8x8 map of the target. Trained from a centred pile with noisy clocks and damage.

s4_ref_global_g8_tn15_dmg_pfc.label: Reference swarm, global attention (upper bound)
s4_ref_global_g8_tn15_dmg_pfc.note: Same training, but every bot sees every other bot.

s2_cond_global.label: Global attention, full map, scattered start
s2_cond_global.note: All-to-all attention. Trained from scattered noise on thin and branching shapes.

s2_cond_local_r60_L4.label: Local radius 0.6, full map, scattered start

s2_cond_local_r40_L4.label: Local radius 0.4, full map, scattered start
s2_cond_local_r40_L4.note: Sensing radius about 4 spacings; watch thin shapes.

s2_cond_local_r25_L4.label: Local radius 0.25, full map, scattered start
s2_cond_local_r25_L4.note: The weak local model; holes and fragments on thin shapes.

s1_cond_local_r40_L4_notime.label: Local radius 0.4, NO clock
s1_cond_local_r40_L4_notime.note: Without a clock the swarm forms bodies but leaves strays.

s3_cond_global_dmg.label: Repair-trained global model
s3_cond_global_dmg.note: Form a shape, then cut a chunk and press repair.

s2pf_cond_global_pf.label: Global, trained from a pile at a random offset
s2pf_cond_global_pf.note: Pile starts anywhere; the demo moves it rigidly first.

s3pf_cond_local_r60_L4_dmg_pf.label: Local radius 0.6, pile start plus repair training

s1_uncond_global_60k.label: Unconditional (no target map): invents a shape
s1_uncond_global_60k.note: Ignores the drawn shape. Every seed gives a new compact shape.

s1_uncond_local_r40_L4.label: Unconditional, local radius 0.4
s1_uncond_local_r40_L4.note: No map and local only: try several seeds.

s6_r60_aux_in5_rep5.label: Local radius 0.6 + geometric losses (best local so far)
s6_r60_aux_in5_rep5.note: Trained to stay inside the shape and not crowd. Visibly tighter than the plain local model.

s6_global_aux_in5_rep5.label: Global attention + geometric losses
s6_global_aux_in5_rep5.note: All-to-all attention with the same extra losses.
